samples.summary: `Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection` — the half that actually restores a cross-tab undo selection — has no test at any layer
samples.evidence: The diff tests both ends of the cross-tab path except the landing: `packages/sheets/test/sheet/undo-selection.test.ts` asserts only that `onUndoTabJump` is called with the selection ("reports a step in another tab instead of moving this one"), and `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-undo.test.ts` asserts only that the store reports `otherTab: true`. Nothing exercises `focusUndoSelection`, which translates that selection into `selectRow`/`selectRowRange`, `selectColumn`/`selectColumnRange` or `selectStart`/`selectEnd` plus `revealActiveCell`. Grepping `focusUndoSelection` across the repo returns only src files (spreadsheet.ts, sheet-view.tsx) and docs — zero test files. If this mapping is wrong (e.g. row/column branch inverted, single-cell `selectEnd` skipped, early return on `!selection.range`), the exact user-visible defect this PR exists to fix — undo appearing to do nothing — ships undetected, and `packages/sheets/test/view/spreadsheet-readonly-recalc.test.ts` shows this class is testable via prototype+hand-built context.

samples.summary: The React cross-tab jump wiring (tab switch, requestId de-duplication, clearing the pending target on history reset) is untested
samples.evidence: `handleUndoJump` in document-detail.tsx (sets activeTabId + undoJumpTarget), the `setUndoJumpTarget(null)` on history reset, and the `lastHandledUndoJumpRequestIdRef` / `selection.tabId !== tabId` guards in sheet-view.tsx have no test. No `sheet-view` or `document-detail` test file exists (glob over packages/frontend/src/**/*.test.tsx lists 35 component tests, none for these). A stale or double-applied jump would move the user's selection unexpectedly after an unrelated undo, but failures are contained to selection placement.

samples.summary: The `merges` operation branch of `resolveUndoSelection` (and its parseRef failure path) has no test
samples.evidence: `collectTouches` handles `case 'merges'` by `parseRef(op.key)` inside a try/catch, but grep for `merges` in packages/sheets/test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts returns no matches, and the frontend yorkie-store test never merges cells. The previous implementation explicitly diffed merges, so this is a behavior the rewrite carried over with no coverage; undoing a merge/unmerge could silently select nothing.

samples.summary: The rangeStyles path is only tested against hand-built snapshots with `as any` casts, never against a real store write
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts covers `diffRangeStyles` by constructing `RangeStylePatch`-shaped literals cast with `as any` and synthesising `{type:'set', path:'$.sheets.<tab>.rangeStyles'}` ops. Nothing verifies that a real `setRangeStyle` through YorkieStore actually produces that op path/shape or that `snapshotTabs`' `cloneRangeStylePatch` copies compare equal via `JSON.stringify` (key-order sensitive). yorkie-store-undo.test.ts covers cells, dimensions and shifts but never a style change, so undoing a style edit could leave the selection unmoved without any test failing.

samples.summary: The new `revealActiveCell` scroll-into-view after undo/redo is untested
samples.evidence: `Worksheet.revealActiveCell` and its two new call sites in `Spreadsheet.undo`/`redo` appear only in src files per grep; no test asserts that a replayed step scrolls its selection into view. Failure is contained (selection is correct, just possibly off-screen) but it is a stated goal of the change.

samples.summary: `rowStyles`/`colStyles` op branches and the weight tiebreak in `pickCandidate` have no direct test
samples.evidence: The workbook test covers `rowHeights` and `colWidths` keys but never `rowStyles`/`colStyles` (same switch arms), and never exercises `pickCandidate`'s `candidate.weight > best.weight` tiebreak between two non-current tabs at equal rank — every multi-tab test either includes the current tab or has a single top-rank candidate.

finding.evidence: The diff tests both ends of the cross-tab path except the landing: `packages/sheets/test/sheet/undo-selection.test.ts` asserts only that `onUndoTabJump` is called with the selection ("reports a step in another tab instead of moving this one"), and `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-undo.test.ts` asserts only that the store reports `otherTab: true`. verdict.reason: `Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection` (packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:689-707) implements its own row/column/cell selection mapping plus render/revealActiveCell/notifySelectionChange, and nothing executes it under test. Repo-wide grep for `focusUndoSelection` yields only the definition, its single caller at packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:1454, and a docs file — zero test files. It is not reached indirectly either: no test imports or renders sheet-view.tsx (checked all *.test.* files mentioning SheetView/sheet-view), and I searched the second frontend test root packages/frontend/tests/** including tests/app/spreadsheet/*, plus all tests mentioning `Spreadsheet`, plus any e2e dir (none exists). The nearest coverage is a distinct implementation, `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:5484-5514), exercised by packages/sheets/test/sheet/undo-selection.test.ts; its cross-tab case at lines 179-198 asserts only that onUndoTabJump fires and that the local cursor does not move — it stops exactly where focusUndoSelection starts. The view mapping even differs from the model's (e.g. selectRowRange only when end.r > start.r), so model coverage does not stand in for it. packages/sheets/test/view/spreadsheet-readonly-recalc.test.ts:23-45 shows the class is testable via prototype + hand-built context, so this is a genuine, avoidable gap over the user-visible behavior the change delivers (undo landing on the right selection after a tab switch) — major, and no counterexample exists.
